title: Mt Martha South Beach Market
summary: Street food and makers market at Mt Martha House and Lawn with sweeping views over Port Phillip Bay. 60+ stalls of high-end goods including fashion, beauty, art, homewares, homemade goods and pet products. Multiple food vans. Held on Victorian public holidays.
